svg.aria-description: The tracking release, from helm template: 8 nodes, 12 connections. 4 workloads and 4 objects around them, imported from a Helm chart rendered with helm template. Traffic flows from each Ingress to the pods behind its Services, and dashed arrows are configuration the pods read.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: The tracking release, from helm template
svg.desc: The tracking release, from helm template: 8 nodes, 12 connections. 4 workloads and 4 objects around them, imported from a Helm chart rendered with helm template. Traffic flows from each Ingress to the pods behind its Services, and dashed arrows are configuration the pods read. Nodes: - Resource group: tracking (Release) - Resource group: tracking (Chart 0.4.0) - tracking (Ingress, api.parcelpoint.example), gateway - tracking-api (Deployment, 2 replicas, port 80), service - tracking-worker (Deployment), service - tracking-config (ConfigMap), storage - Resource group: postgresql (Chart 15.5.20) - tracking-postgresql (StatefulSet, port 5432), database - tracking-postgresql (Secret), secret - Resource group: rabbitmq (Chart 14.6.6) - tracking-rabbitmq (StatefulSet, port 5672), queue - tracking-rabbitmq (Secret), secret Connections: - tracking to tracking-api: api.parcelpoint.example - tracking-api to tracking-postgresql - tracking-api to tracking-rabbitmq - tracking-api to tracking-config (dashed): reads - tracking-api to tracking-postgresql (dashed, identity line): reads - tracking-worker to tracking-postgresql - tracking-worker to tracking-rabbitmq - tracking-worker to tracking-config (dashed): reads - tracking-worker to tracking-postgresql (dashed, identity line): reads - tracking-worker to tracking-rabbitmq (dashed, identity line): reads - tracking-postgresql to tracking-postgresql (dashed, identity line): reads - tracking-rabbitmq to tracking-rabbitmq (dashed, identity line): reads
